definitions.full: H6811. Tsair II. [ צָעִיר ] proper name, of a location probably on border of Edom, צָעִ֫ירָה 2Kin 8:21 , εἰς Σειωρ ( ᵐ5 L ἐκ Σιωρ ).

occurrences.englishText: Then Joram passed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, and the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.
